_doc: Parallel-agent file-ownership registry. The preToolUse hook (.cursor/hooks/check-file-ownership.py) reads this. SAFE BY DEFAULT: with enforce=false nothing is ever blocked. To activate mutual exclusion: (1) set enforce=true, (2) add claims with disjoint globs, (3) each parallel agent/worktree exports CURSOR_AGENT_OWNER=<its owner label> before editing. A Write/Delete to a path matching another owner's active claim is denied.
